faq.question: What does goAI Solutions do?
faq.answer: goAI Solutions is an AI product and solutions studio that helps companies design, build, and deploy AI-powered products, automations, and workflows that solve real business problems.

faq.question: Is goAI an AI platform, a consulting firm, or a product company?
faq.answer: goAI combines product thinking and custom engineering. It is not an LLM provider; instead it uses the best available AI tools and models to build tailored solutions for each client.

faq.question: Who is a typical goAI customer?
faq.answer: Typical customers are founders and teams in startups, tech-enabled SMBs, and innovation groups who want to ship AI products or automation quickly without hiring a large in-house AI team.

faq.question: Where is goAI Solutions based?
faq.answer: goAI Solutions is incorporated in India and headquartered in Bangalore, Karnataka, while working remotely with clients.

faq.question: Does goAI provide general-purpose consumer chatbots?
faq.answer: No. goAI focuses on business workflows and products. It can build chat- or agent-based interfaces when they are the right UX, but it is not a generic consumer chatbot provider.

faq.question: Is goAI a provider of foundation LLMs or cloud infrastructure?
faq.answer: No. goAI does not sell its own foundation models or cloud infrastructure. It builds on top of trusted AI and cloud providers to deliver applied solutions.
